notes.title: Added Controller Support
notes.content:
Game should now be fully playable via a controller; tested under Steam Input default settings. 

note 1: there is no in-game configurations/mapping. The controller's thumbstick should be able to select/deselect buttons, and the controller's default button for confirm should work i.e. button 'A' on a xbox controller

note 2: still need to press the Esc key to quit the game
